takeaways: The Karnataka government plans to develop nine integrated industrial townships across the Bengaluru Metropolitan Region.
The project covers 13500 acres and aims to add 6.5 lakh homes over the next decade.

items.title: Prof Mohan Krishnamoorthy is BITS Pilani Amaravati’s director
takeaways: BITS Pilani appointed Prof Mohan Krishnamoorthy as the Director of its Amaravati campus.
He will assume charge in January 2027 to lead development and academic expansion.

items.title: Karnataka Plans to Extend AI Training in Government Schools to Class 6
takeaways: Karnataka is considering expanding its artificial intelligence training initiative to younger students in government schools.
Chief Minister D K Shivakumar directed officials to extend the program down to Class 6.

items.title: May harm democracy: Chandigarh court orders block of AI-generated videos targeting Congress politician
takeaways: A Chandigarh court restrained three Facebook pages from circulating AI-generated videos targeting a politician.
The ruling sets a legal precedent against malicious deepfakes and AI misuse in political campaigns.

items.title: Technology Leader Samartha Nagabhushanam's Journey Spans Telecom, AI and Startup Ecosystem
takeaways: Technology leader Samartha Nagabhushanam spans telecom, AI, and startup ecosystems in Bengaluru.
Profile highlights decades of executive experience in building enterprise technology ventures.

items.title: Space Bank: Robots Respond on-site Based on Urban Data Analysis… Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Award for AI City Operations
takeaways: Space Bank received the Minister of Land Infrastructure and Transport Award for AI city operations.
The award highlights advancements in urban data analysis and on-site robotic responses in South Korea.

items.title: Karnataka takes a citizen-first step towards using AI for public good
takeaways: Karnataka signed an MoU to promote citizen-centric AI applications through government innovation societies.
The initiative benchmarks neighboring state policies in public sector artificial intelligence adoption.

items.title: Alpha Compute signs contract for NVIDIA B300 GPU cluster in Sweden
takeaways: Alpha Compute signed a commercial contract to deploy an NVIDIA B300 GPU cluster in Sweden.
The high-performance computing infrastructure will support advanced computational workloads in Europe.

items.title: Saudi Arabia to regularise status of illegal Yemeni nationals
takeaways: Saudi Arabia announced plans to regularise the residency status of illegal Yemeni nationals in the Kingdom.
The directive was issued following orders from King Salman and the Ministry of Interior.

items.title: POCSO case: Bandi Sai Bageerath moves Telangana HC against alleged ‘media trial’
takeaways: Bandi Sai Bageerath approached the Telangana High Court regarding a POCSO case and media trial.
The petitioner sought relief from alleged biased media reporting following previously granted bails.

items.title: Google's $15 billion AI bet hits a green hurdle: Why Finland has halted work at two data centre sites?
takeaways: Finnish authorities halted work on two Google data center sites due to environmental impact assessment requirements.
Global tech giants face stringent ecological hurdles even during multibillion-dollar AI infrastructure expansions.
